title: Lion cub eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M18 72 Q8 65 12 52' stroke='#d4902a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='50' r='5' fill='#a06010'/>
  
  <!-- back leg -->
  <rect x='26' y='72' width='12' height='14' rx='5' fill='#d4902a'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='86' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#c07818'/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='70' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#e8a830'/>
  
  <!-- front leg -->
  <rect x='56' y='74' width='11' height='13' rx='5' fill='#d4902a'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='87' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#c07818'/>
  
  <!-- chest lighter patch -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='80' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#f5c860'/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='46' r='22' fill='#e8a830'/>
  
  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='46' r='22' fill='none' stroke='#c07818' stroke-width='6'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='46' r='22' fill='none' stroke='#a86010' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='30' r='6' fill='#e8a830'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='30' r='3' fill='#f5c860'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='30' r='6' fill='#e8a830'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='30' r='3' fill='#f5c860'/>
  
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='56' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f5c860'/>
  
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='49' cy='43' r='4' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='43' r='4' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M52 51 L58 51 L55 55 Z' fill='#8a4a10'/>
  
  <!-- mouth open eating -->
  <path d='M48 58 Q55 64 62 58' stroke='#8a4a10' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- snack: meat/biscuit held in paws -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='66' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#c03020'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='66' rx='10' ry='7' fill='none' stroke='#e05040' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='64' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff6a5a'/>
  
  <!-- little paws holding snack -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='66' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#d4902a'/>
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='66' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#d4902a'/>
  
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='40' y1='54' x2='30' y2='51' stroke='#c07818' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='57' x2='30' y2='58' stroke='#c07818' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='54' x2='80' y2='51' stroke='#c07818' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='57' x2='80' y2='58' stroke='#c07818' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- happy eyebrows -->
  <path d='M44 37 Q49 34 54 37' stroke='#a86010' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 37 Q65 34 70 37' stroke='#a86010' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- crumbs -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='70' r='1.5' fill='#e05040'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='1.5' fill='#e05040'/>
</svg>
